title: Open your first rift
successMessage: Zrix chirps approvingly. You can now open and name a session.

steps.instruction: Type tmux and press Enter to open a raw session.
steps.helix: A session is the first rift. Open one before you worry about managing it.

steps.instruction: Now name the rift with tmux new -s clulix.
steps.helix: Names turn vague memory into reliable navigation.

title: Leave the rift without killing it
successMessage: Vrex nods. The rift remains alive even after you step away.

steps.instruction: Press Ctrl+b, then d to detach from the active session.
steps.helix: Detach is the heart of tmux. Work survives your absence.

title: Prove the rift persisted
successMessage: The CLULIX beacon hums back to life. Session persistence confirmed.

steps.instruction: Type tmux ls to inspect every session still on the planet.
steps.helix: Listing gives you orientation before you leap.

steps.instruction: Re-enter your ship session with tmux attach -t clulix.
steps.helix: Attach is how you step back into suspended work.

title: Act 2: Rescue Redshirt across live views
successMessage: Redshirt steps through the rescue view. The party is reunited.

steps.instruction: Press Ctrl+b, then c to open a rescue view without leaving this Rift.
steps.helix: A window is another live view inside the same session. Open one for Redshirt's signal.

steps.instruction: Press Ctrl+b, then w to inspect every live view.
steps.helix: Inspect the available views before choosing where to act.

steps.instruction: Press Ctrl+b, then p to return to the previous view and pull Redshirt through.
steps.helix: Previous and next let you move between tasks without abandoning the session.

title: Act 3: Assemble Commander Sock's scanner
successMessage: Sock's scanner resolves the hidden Rift storm. Parallel monitoring is online.

steps.instruction: Press Ctrl+b, then % to split a vertical scanner pane.
steps.helix: Panes keep simultaneous operations visible inside one view.

steps.instruction: Press Ctrl+b, then " to split a horizontal threat-monitor pane.
steps.helix: A second split gives the party another live instrument without losing the first.

steps.instruction: Press Ctrl+b, then x to close the corrupted pane while preserving the scanner.
steps.helix: Close only the failed subprocess. The rest of the operation must survive.
